title: 第7章 艳惊四座第8章 黄昏下的约定
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
叮！
任务内容：在开蒙仪式上打通至少七个脉门。
任务奖励：完成度越高，奖励越丰厚。
苟系统得意地看向陆沉，心里想到：“有人惦记女主，男主强势打脸，这不是妥妥的爽文剧情吗？七个脉门，对气运之子来说不是洒洒水吗？去吧少年！
去打他们的脸！”
陆沉二话不说，这任务符合他的性格，果断选择接取。
这时陆沉远远看见自己的父母正坐在宗祠外的一排椅子上，连忙走上前去，恭恭敬敬地行了一礼：“父亲，母亲。”
陆父名叫陆凯之，陆母名叫高丽华。
“沉儿，几日不见又壮实了不少，今日可要好好表现，可不要丢了为父的人啊！”
陆凯之拍了拍陆沉的肩膀，欣慰地看着自己的儿子。
“儿子，别听你爸的，自己尽力就好。”
高丽华温柔地看着陆沉，眼里满是慈爱。
“儿子定不会让父亲母亲失望！”
陆沉满脸都是自信。
“沉儿，可别说大话闪了舌头啊！”
这时一个不和谐的声音响起，来人是一个身材矮胖的中年男人，此人正是陆沉的二叔，也是陆升的父亲陆泽之，自从陆沉爷爷退位让陆凯之担任家主后，他这二叔就怀恨在心，时常搞些小动作侵吞家族利益，更是经常在人前和陆凯之对着干，完全不给自己大哥这个家主面子。
“二叔！”
陆沉敷衍地行了一礼。
“哼！
老二，你刚才说的是什么话？”

陆凯之平日里顾念着兄弟情谊，所以对陆泽之的小动作也都是睁一只眼闭一只眼的态度，但脾气好不代表没有底线，事关自己的儿子，自然要有脾气。
“大哥，我也只是实话实说而已，你这家主不会不让人说实话吧？可不是所有人都能像我家升儿一样打通七个脉门的，沉儿还是不要太好高骛远的好。
免得说大话丢了陆家的颜面。”
陆泽之一脸恶心的笑容。
“你！”
陆凯之怒拍了一下桌子，这边的声音很快吸引了周边人的目光，一些不嫌事大的已经准备好吃瓜了。
“父亲稍安勿躁！”
陆沉拦住正在暴走边缘的陆凯之，随即看向陆泽之，自信地说道：“今天就让孩儿来告诉二叔，什么叫跳梁小丑！”
“大侄子，跳梁小丑可别说的是自己。
哼！”
陆泽之气愤地甩袖离开了。
随着时间推移，开蒙仪式也到了开始的时候。
坐在椅子上的分别是陆家家主陆凯之，陆家三位长老，以及陆家所在乌泽城的城主，而在城主旁边坐着的赫然是沈雪见的师父。
“雪见的师父，看起来好像地位很高的样子。”
陆沉小声嘀咕着。
“你还有心思关心这些？给我打起精神来，狠狠地打那些人的脸！”
自从见识到陆沉那夸张的运气后，9527渐渐相信陆沉会是天命主角那种人，态度也愈发嚣张起来，完全没了之前那股苟劲儿。
“放心啦！
十拿九稳的事情。”
陆沉也是极度的自信。

所谓开蒙仪式，就是未开蒙者将手放在开蒙碑上感悟天地元气，从而打开脉门，脉门的多少直接关系到此人日后的修炼速度，最多九个，最少则是一个都没有的普通人。
content_en:
bite!
Mission content: Open at least seven meridians during the initiation ceremony.
Mission rewards: The higher the completion level, the more generous the rewards.
Gou System looked at Lu Chen proudly and thought in his mind: "Someone is thinking about the heroine, and the hero slaps her in the face. Isn't this a good plot? Seven veins, isn't it a blessing for a child of luck? Go ahead, boy!"
Go slap them in the face! "
Lu Chen said nothing. This task suited his personality and he decisively chose to take it.
At this time, Lu Chen saw his parents sitting on a row of chairs outside the ancestral hall from a distance. He quickly walked forward and bowed respectfully: "Father, mother."
Lu's father's name is Lu Kaizhi, and Lu's mother's name is Gao Lihua.
"Shen'er, I haven't seen you for a few days and you have gotten a lot stronger. You have to behave well today and don't lose your father!"
Lu Kaizhi patted Lu Chen's shoulder and looked at his son with relief.
"Son, don't listen to your father, just do your best."
Gao Lihua looked at Lu Chen tenderly, her eyes full of love.
"My son will never disappoint his father and mother!"
Lu Chen's face was full of confidence.
"Shen'er, don't talk nonsense and flash your tongue!"
At this time, a discordant voice sounded. The person who came was a short and fat middle-aged man. This man was Lu Chen's second uncle and Lu Sheng's father, Lu Zezhi. Ever since Grandpa Lu Chen abdicated and Lu Kaizhi became the head of the family, his second uncle had held a grudge and often made small moves to embezzle the family's interests. He often confronted Lu Kaizhi in front of others, completely denying his eldest brother, the head of the family, face.
"Second uncle!"
Lu Chen bowed perfunctorily.
"Hmph!
Second child, what did you just say? "
Lu Kaizhi usually cares about brotherhood, so he turns a blind eye to Lu Zezhi's little actions. But having a good temper does not mean there is no bottom line. When it comes to his son, he must have a temper.
"Brother, I'm just telling the truth. You, the head of the family, won't let people tell the truth, right? Not everyone can open the seven veins like my Sheng'er. It's better for Shen'er not to be too ambitious.
So as not to lose face of the Lu family by talking big words. "
Lu Zezhi had a disgusting smile on his face.
"You!"
Lu Kaizhi slapped the table angrily, and the sound quickly attracted the attention of the people around him. Some people who didn't mind the matter were already ready to eat.
"Father, please be patient!"
Lu Chen stopped Lu Kaizhi who was on the verge of going berserk, then looked at Lu Zezhi and said confidently: "Let me tell my second uncle today what a clown is!"
"My nephew, don't talk about yourself as a clown.
Hum! "
Lu Zezhi threw up his sleeves angrily and left.
As time passed, it was time for the initiation ceremony to begin.
Sitting on the chairs were the head of the Lu family, Lu Kaizhi, the three elders of the Lu family, and the city lord of Wuze City where the Lu family was located. Sitting next to the city lord was Shen Xuejian's master.
"Xue Jian's master looks like he has a very high status."
Lu Chen muttered softly.
"Do you still care about this? Cheer up and slap those people in the face!"
After seeing Lu Chen's exaggerated luck, 9527 gradually believed that Lu Chen would be the kind of person who was destined to be the protagonist, and his attitude became more and more arrogant, completely losing the stubbornness he had before.
"Don't worry!
A sure thing. "
Lu Chen is also extremely confident.
The so-called enlightenment ceremony means that the uninitiated person puts his hand on the enlightenment stele to feel the vitality of heaven and earth, thereby opening the vein gate. The number of vein gates is directly related to the person's future cultivation speed. The maximum is nine, and the minimum is an ordinary person who has none.
